raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
 Step Number: 4
 Reason for Mistake: It misreported Thietmar of Meissen’s death date as 1 December 1018 by conflating him with a different Thietmar (likely the Bishop of Merseburg) and relying on a search snippet instead of verifying the page content. This leads directly to an incorrect death date for Gero II’s father (who died on 3 August 979).
